module: Exit guard for the pause menu's vehicle configuration screen. When the UI reports unapplied changes (setHasPendingChanges), any navigation away from the screen is intercepted by confirmExit: a confirmation dialog (Cancel / Discard / Apply) is shown and the navigation is held pending, then resumed once the decision is made. Useful to a modder who adds a configuration sub-route or wants to understand why a navigation is blocked.
usage:
ui_pause_vehicleConfigurationGuard.setHasPendingChanges(true)
-- the router then calls confirmExit(route, params, context) before leaving the screen
notes: The sub-routes pause.vehicle.configurationcombined.save, .configlistmanage and .mirrors never trigger the dialog (SUB_ROUTES table).

confirmExit returns false when it blocks the navigation; it is then replayed via ui_router.navigate by resumePendingExit with a bypass flag (exitConfirmationBypass) so as not to ask for confirmation again.
The pending target is always refreshed on each confirmExit call: a dialog closed without a callback therefore does not block navigation indefinitely.
Unapplied changes exist only in the UI; discarding simply means continuing the navigation.

setHasPendingChanges.desc: Indicates whether the configuration screen contains unapplied changes. Any value other than true is converted to false.

value.desc: true if there are pending changes

navigateBack.desc: Navigates to the return route: core_vehicle_configTarget.getReturnRoute() if the extension is loaded, otherwise "pause.vehicle". Uses the option restoreLastScope = true.

confirmExit.desc: Called before leaving the screen. Returns true (navigation allowed) if the bypass is active, if there are no pending changes, if the route name is invalid or if it is a configuration sub-route. Otherwise stores the requested navigation, shows the showConfirmationDialog dialog (buttons Cancel, Discard, Apply) and returns false.

route.desc: Target route; its name field is used if context.routeName is absent

context.desc: Router context: routeName and options (inferred from code)

returns.desc: true if navigation can continue, false if it is suspended pending the dialog

cancelExit.desc: Callback of the Cancel button: forgets the pending navigation.

confirmExitDiscarding.desc: Callback of the Discard button: resumes the pending navigation without applying the changes.

returns.desc: Result of the replayed navigation, or false if nothing was pending

confirmExitApplying.desc: Callback of the Apply button: triggers the UI event VehicleConfigurationCombinedApplyAndExit. The pending parts tree and tuning live in the UI, which applies them then calls resumePendingExit() back.

resumePendingExit.desc: Replays the pending navigation, bypassing the confirmation. Returns false if there is no pending navigation.
